name: remove.bg
summary: Automatic image background removal, with optional crop, shadow and new background.

api_key.description: A remove.bg API key (remove.bg dashboard > API Keys). Sent in the X-Api-Key header.

notes: remove.bg's API page says background removal moves to Leonardo.Ai starting December 1, 2026; check the API page before relying on this entry after that date.
Credits: preview size (up to 0.25 MP) costs 0.25 credit, full and 50MP cost 1 credit per image; the X-Credits-Charged response header gives the real charge. The first 50 API calls per month are free.
Rate limit is 500 megapixel-images per minute (a 10 MP input counts as 10); a 429 is not charged and carries Retry-After.
Only one image source per call: image_url or image_file_b64 (file uploads need multipart and are not covered here).
The answer is the image bytes unless the Accept header is application/json, which returns the result base64-encoded in JSON.

endpoints.name: Remove an image's background
endpoints.summary: Foreground cutout of a JPG, PNG or WebP image from a URL or base64 data.

image_url.description: Source image URL (exactly one of image_url or image_file_b64).

image_file_b64.description: Source image as a base64 string; up to 22 MB and 50 megapixels.

size.description: Output resolution: preview (default, 0.25 MP, 0.25 credit), full (up to 25 MP, 1 credit), 50MP (1 credit) or auto (highest available).

format.description: Result format; auto (default) is PNG when transparent, else JPG. zip is fastest.

crop.description: Crop off empty regions; default false.

crop_margin.description: Margin around the cropped subject, e.g. 30px or 10%.

scale.description: Subject size relative to the canvas, 10% to 100%, or original (default).

position.description: original, center, or a percentage (one or two values).

channels.description: rgba (default, finished image) or alpha (mask only).

shadow_type.description: Shadow: car, 3D, drop, none, or auto.

bg_color.description: Solid background colour, hex (81d4fa) or a name (green).

bg_image_url.description: Background image URL to place behind the subject.

accept.description: application/json to get the result base64-encoded in JSON instead of image bytes.

notes: A read over POST that spends credits (see size). 400 errors are not charged.

endpoints.name: Get credit balance and free calls
endpoints.summary: Total, subscription, pay-as-you-go and enterprise credits, plus remaining free API calls.
notes: Balance changes can lag several seconds; track spend with the X-Credits-Charged header instead of polling this.
